0022600095.text: Dallas (0-1, 5th in the Southwest, 1 game back, 11th in the West) visits Indiana (1-0, 2nd in the Central, 7th in the East) in the Mavericks' second game of the season. Dallas is without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel), and Jett Howard is day-to-day with a calf injury and a game-time decision. Indiana is missing Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), while Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain) and Ben Sheppard (knee soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Dallas won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 134-130 Mavericks win in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026.
